annotations.title: WLFI buyback tracker: how much World Liberty has bought, the pace and the days left

description: The World Liberty Financial WLFI buyback (announced 06-11-2026, buying began 09-11-2026 with 10,000,000 USD1 put on Aster), read by OwlChart from the Aster WLFI/USD1 spot pair (v5.888): bought so far (estimated from taker buys above the baseline of the ten days before), percent of the 10,000,000 USD1 used, pace per day over the last 7 days, days left at that pace and the date it lasts until, the flow of the last 24 hours, the size and rhythm of the buy orders, the flow by day with the WLFI close, the WLFI price since the announcement and since the start, and what World Liberty has published (wallet, total budget, burn or hold: null until published). An estimate from public exchange data, never a World Liberty figure. Page: owlchart.com/wlfi.html.
